## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes and new behavior has tests
- [ ] No secrets, real incident data or customer telemetry included
- [ ] Security-relevant decisions remain deterministic (not left to the LLM)
- [ ] Docs or README updated if needed
